mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.authrt_cd, u.user_email, u.user_phn_num, u.user_birth, u.user_gender, u.user_addr, u.join_ymd, u.user_nm, u.user_pst_ablty, u.user_pst, u.user_level, u.user_intro, f.file_path, t.team_cd, t.team_nm, t.rgn_nm, t.gender, ta.team_age_name AS ageGroup, t.act_dow, l.tier AS level, u.is_profile_public, u.is_level_hidden FROM user u LEFT JOIN files f ON u.user_img = f.file_idx LEFT JOIN team_user tu ON u.user_id = tu.user_cd LEFT JOIN team t ON tu.team_cd = t.team_cd LEFT JOIN team_age ta ON t.team_age = ta.team_age_cd LEFT JOIN levels l ON t.level_cd = l.level_cd WHERE u.user_email = #{email}
mapper.update:
UPDATE user
user_nm = #{name},
user_intro = #{intro},
user_pst = #{pst},
user_pst_ablty = #{pstAblty},
user_addr = #{addr},
user_img = #{profile},
WHERE user_email = #{email}
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_nm AS nickname, u.user_pst AS position, u.user_addr AS region, CASE WHEN u.is_level_hidden = 1 THEN NULL ELSE u.user_level END AS level, u.user_intro AS intro, CONCAT(f.file_path, '/', f.file_new_name) AS profileImageUrl FROM user u LEFT JOIN files f ON f.file_idx = u.user_img WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.is_profile_public = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT t.team_cd AS teamCd, t.team_nm AS teamNm, t.rgn_nm AS rgnNm, t.gender AS gender, ta.team_age_name AS ageGroup, t.act_dow AS actDow, l.tier AS level, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_user tu2 WHERE tu2.team_cd = t.team_cd ) AS memberCount FROM team t JOIN team_user tu ON t.team_cd = tu.team_cd JOIN user u ON tu.user_cd = u.user_id LEFT JOIN team_age ta ON t.team_age = ta.team_age_cd LEFT JOIN levels l ON t.level_cd = l.level_cd WHERE u.user_email = #{email}

SELECT m.match_no AS matchNo, m.match_date AS matchDate, m.match_time AS matchTime, f.field_nm AS stadium, m.gender_nm AS genderNm,
mt.match_type_nm AS matchTypeNm, mt.total_players AS totalCount,
COUNT(DISTINCT a_all.user_id) AS currentCount,
l1.tier AS minLevel, l2.tier AS maxLevel FROM match_applications a JOIN matches m ON m.match_no = a.match_no JOIN fields f ON f.field_no = m.field_no LEFT JOIN levels l1 ON l1.level_cd = m.min_level_cd LEFT JOIN levels l2 ON l2.level_cd = m.max_level_cd JOIN user u ON u.user_id = a.user_id
LEFT JOIN match_applications a_all ON a_all.match_no = m.match_no
LEFT JOIN match_types mt ON mt.match_type_cd = m.match_type_cd
WHERE u.user_email = #{email} GROUP BY m.match_no, m.match_date, m.match_time, f.field_nm, m.gender_nm, mt.match_type_nm, mt.total_players, l1.tier, l2.tier ORDER BY m.match_date, m.match_time
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM match_applications WHERE user_id = (SELECT user_id FROM user WHERE user_email = #{email}) AND match_no = #{matchNo}
mapper.select: SELECT m.match_no AS matchNo, DATE_FORMAT(m.match_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS matchDate, LPAD(SUBSTRING(CAST(m.match_time AS CHAR), 1, 5), 5, '0') AS matchTime, f.field_nm AS stadium, m.gender_nm AS genderNm, mt.match_type_nm AS matchTypeNm, l1.tier AS minLevel, l2.tier AS maxLevel, IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM match_applications a WHERE a.match_no = m.match_no), 0) AS currentCount, mt.total_players AS totalCount, TRUE AS isLiked FROM match_likes ml JOIN user u ON u.user_id = ml.user_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_no = ml.match_no LEFT JOIN fields f ON f.field_no = m.field_no LEFT JOIN levels l1 ON l1.level_cd = m.min_level_cd LEFT JOIN levels l2 ON l2.level_cd = m.max_level_cd LEFT JOIN match_types mt ON mt.match_type_cd = m.match_type_cd WHERE u.user_email = #{email} ORDER BY m.match_date ASC, m.match_time ASC

SELECT m.match_no, m.match_date, m.match_time, f.field_nm AS stadium, m.match_type_cd, r.home_score, r.away_score, r.winner FROM match_results r JOIN matches m ON r.match_no = m.match_no JOIN fields f ON m.field_no = f.field_no WHERE m.match_stts_no = 3
SELECT u.is_profile_public AS isProfilePublic, u.is_level_hidden AS isLevelHidden FROM user u WHERE u.user_email = #{email}
mapper.update:
UPDATE user
is_profile_public = #{isProfilePublic},
is_level_hidden = #{isLevelHidden},
WHERE user_email = #{email}
